source: Owner direct chat after the GASPALS enemy integration plan and task split
owner_message_original: Тогда сделай это сейчас вне задачи пожалуйста
owner_message_english_translation: Then please do this now outside a task.
decision: Implement the proposed GASPALS armed-mannequin integration directly, outside Multica task creation and dispatch.
scope: Adapt the local GASPALS rifle animation layers, weapon attachment and grip, independent aiming and movement, and crouched rifle stance to the existing GASP/Mover enemy foundation. Begin with one pilot, integrate existing physical hit/balance/fall/get-up/death transitions, then deliver all three existing fixtures. Preserve the latest physical tuning and corrections.
scope_boundary: This starts the proposed armed-mannequin integration. Autonomous perception, navigation and combat remain in MSQ-70; disarming, wound gestures and expanded terrain/balance work retain their separate scope. No new Multica issue or task runtime is needed.
execution: One native implementation agent owns code and Unreal editing, at explicitly configured Astra/max and standard speed. The controller owns administration, evidence acceptance and the local closure commit. Existing services and applications may be launched as required for authorized work.
verification: Focused build and affected runtime/visual transition checks, followed by one independent primary technical review. The request to work outside a task does not waive review. Owner subjective motion/play acceptance remains separate.
acceptance: All three existing fixture profiles render with an attached rifle and adapted GASPALS presentation; demonstrate shared behavior on one representative.
Relax, Ready and Aim blend with commanded movement, stopping, directional aiming and crouch/stand; document movement/capsule and skeleton compatibility.
Record movement, real impact, physical recovery or fall/get-up, and return to armed movement without competing body targets or stale hand grips.
Verify directly affected death, reset/recreation and relative slowdown transitions; retain one authoritative damage path and existing tuning.
Provide the applicable native build result, ordinary-speed actual views, controls, changed-file identities and source/owner preservation evidence.
review_ownership: One primary independent native reviewer covers implementation correctness, focused test adequacy and actual affected visual transitions. The controller accepts scope, candidate identity, evidence applicability and finding closure.
preservation: Preserve D:/devgames/GASPALS_UE58 source assets, historical candidates and evidence, the retained lobby, first-person player/arms/camera, fixture profile identities and unrelated owner edits. Avoid wholesale GASPALS config or sample-pawn replacement.
